knownUnfixedAdvisories.name: PixelSmash
knownUnfixedAdvisories.description: Heap out-of-bounds write in the MagicYUV decoder, reachable from a crafted AVI, MKV, or MOV

notes: Removal of the bundled FFmpeg module (P2 item) is the complete fix. This policy bounds the exposure by rejecting containers that can carry MagicYUV before they reach FFmpeg's demuxer.
